label: input h late in the original phase (position >= 5)
explanation: Fires almost only when the input token is h at original position 5-8 (87% of activation mass on h; rate rises with position, 15x lift at orig_idx 7-8; never at positions 0-4 and never in the copy phase). A small remainder (~5% of mass) is weak firing on <DEL> or the token after h. Only ~5% of late h steps fire, so precision is low. Firing is more likely and stronger when earlier inputs include x, z, t, v, m (e.g. a sequence starting m or with x at position 1). Requiring >=2 of those raises precision to ~15% but recall falls to 57%. The strongest example is h right after m x z t v. Does not fire on h at early positions or on other letters/digits.
